content.content: deccy implements whole-operation undo and redo with boundary markers over the jj operation log: as an operation runs, deccy records its pre- and post-operation operation ids; undo restores the pre-operation operation, redo restores the post-operation operation. deccy keeps no state snapshots of its own, only the markers.
content.rationale: One jj operation is finer than one deccy operation, so bare jj undo cannot undo a deccy operation; boundaries recover operation granularity, and the markers are untracked pointers to jj's own snapshots.
